name: Immersive source provenance and reuse policy
policy: A source being public on GitHub does not imply permission to copy it.
Vendor source only when the repository grants a compatible reuse licence and required notices/assets are understood.
Reference-only sources contribute transferable interaction principles, not protected code, copy, branding, artwork, media or exact choreography.
Pinned commits make research reproducible; re-review licence and provenance before refreshing a pin.
